greeting.text: Oh! Hello! I'm Kahono, from the Seabed Temple! Well, I used to be. Now I'm from... the sky? The sky is so big!
Welcome, {player}! Songs can close wounds, you know. Mine do. Mostly. I'll sing for you sometime!
My brother says I talk too much. Do you think that's true? Don't answer that!
You're the one bringing down the champions! Everyone's talking about you! I'm going to write a song about it!
{player}! You came back! I wrote a new verse!

hint.text: If you ever learn Song magic, you can sing it with your own voice! Speak into your microphone, or hold the Sing key if you don't have one.
Healing Hymn is for friends, Lullaby for anyone who needs to stop, Barrier Chorus to push foes away, and Requiem for when there is no other way.
My Crescendo answers only to my own grimoire. But every other song is yours to learn!
I want to be an idol, you know. The first idol of the surface! I think I'd be good at it.
My brother Kiato is serious about everything. I'm serious about only a few things. Mostly singing.
I've never seen so many stars! Do you have this many where you come from?
A song in your head helps in a fight. Hum something! Anything!
No champions yet? Then everything is still ahead of you! That's the best kind of song.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun frightens me. But we'll face things like that together, right?
Vetto is gone? Then Kiato and I can finally breathe. Thank you, thank you!
Everyone in the Spade Kingdom looks so sad in the stories. I hope songs can reach them too.
Lucius frightens even the captains. So I'll sing the loudest for whoever goes to face him!
So many strangers from other worlds in the Chronicle! Imagine the songs they must know!

farewell.text: Come back and tell me everything! I'll sing about it!
